verdict.rationale: Lovable documents built-in publishing that deploys a snapshot of the project to a shareable live URL (default xxx.lovable.app). It takes two clicks with working defaults, and it can also be triggered from chat with 'publish my app'. The platform hosts the app with no infrastructure setup. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the one-step publish flow; the community evidence does not address publishing.

support.subject: As a founder, I can publish my app to a live URL in one step

citations.quote: Publishing turns your Lovable project into a live web app by deploying a snapshot to a URL you can share.
Publishing takes two clicks, and the defaults work for most projects
Ask Lovable to publish, deploy, ship, or go live, and it handles the deploy for you while respecting all publish-related workspace settings and permissions.
Lovable hosts your app and includes a built-in backend (Cloud) with database, authentication, storage, edge functions, and AI, no infrastructure setup required.
